conflicts.summary: 'Sulfatfrei'/'No sulfates' claim vs INCI: no sulfate surfactant (no SLS/SLES), but Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate and Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate are sulfonate/sulfosuccinate surfactants. Consistent in the strict sense; 'Avocado- und Macadamiaöl' present (Persea Gratissima Oil, Macadamia Integrifolia Seed Oil).

canonicalReason: Two independent GTIN-anchored German retailers (Rossmann.de and Hagel-Shop, both EAN 4895248005872, 354 ml) agree character for character on a 24-item list on 2026-10-10. The only manufacturer page found is the brand's US site (manufacturer_foreign), which describes a different formula and is preserved as a conflict, not merged. No EU/DE manufacturer page exists in the sources reachable.
normalization: Canonical list split on ',' at parenthesis depth 0 (so synonym groups such as 'Aqua (Water, Eau)' stay one item), trailing full stop removed; per item: lower-case, trim, collapse internal whitespace; asterisks, parentheses and slashes kept as published; items joined with '|'; sha256 over the UTF-8 string.
notes: Differs from the v1.4 pilot canonical list by the missing trailing TETRAMETHYL ACETYLOCTAHYDRONAPHTHALENES (fragrance-related); v1.4 fingerprint e5044d605889525955db74baae6763d31653baa3ce5d6e8fe73586db1db139e6 (comma-joined, 25 items) therefore does not apply to this list.
Product is Rossmann 'Nur Online' and available in 5 variants; the 354 ml Big Hair variant is the one frozen.
